Post Date: 2019-03-12T13:13:17Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Prebuffer next MediaSource in dynamic ConcatenatingMediaSource
Description: ### [REQUIRED] Searched documentation and issues
> You can call any of these methods before and after playback has started, no matter which item is currently playing. Access to these methods is thread-safe. And you can also rest assured that ExoPlayer pre-buffers the next playlist items to ensure gapless playback.

I've found only this general description about prebuffering on Medium, want to get into more details.

### [REQUIRED] Question
I compose a playlist dynamically with ConcatenatingMediaSource and want to ensure that the next MediaSource is prebuffered after it's added with addMediaSource().

For example, there is 1 source in ConcatenatingMediaSource that is currently playing. I add a second one with addMediaSource().

When a player will start to prebuffer it?

- Immediately after adding? 
- Or should I call SimpleExoPlayer.prepare() after adding without reseting position/state?- 
- How about default caching behavior, if the currently playing MediaSource is not buffered to the end at the moment, will the added MediaSource will start buffering after adding?
